prompt: Vertical 9:16 candid night photo on 35 mm colour-negative stock, coarse grain, slight halation, slightly underexposed, the feeling of a real photograph not a render. Shot on a wider 28 mm lens from close in, at eye height across the back seat of a large black luxury car, so the cabin bends a little at the edges; his head sits in the upper half of the frame. A fat, posh English politician in his early fifties lounges sideways with his belly pushing his shirt buttons, utterly bored, eyes rolled up toward the roof lining, talking flatly mid-word with his mouth half open. A thick, wild haystack of straw-yellow hair, never brushed, tumbles down across his forehead. His face: a broad flattened nose, small round brown eyes, a pouting lower lip, a wide jaw softened by a double chin, a sallow complexion. Phone held to his right ear in his right hand, a signet ring on the little finger; his left hand hovers over a small silver tray of canapés on the armrest, tiny sausage rolls and quail eggs. Expensive navy suit jacket rucked up around his shoulders, white shirt untucked at the waist, a dark navy tie with thin stripes pulled loose. Light: a warm overhead reading lamp directly above makes a golden halo in his hair; the phone glow lights his cheek; cold blue emergency strobes blaze through the rain-streaked rear and side windows, blue light sliding across the wet glass and the black leather, with sodium-orange street lamps glowing beyond. Natural skin and natural five-fingered hands. No readable text, no logos, no plates. Thanks.
